name: Section-curve example: 10% chord (curves)
data_origin: Geometry comes from supplied sections, not the earlier left-wing template. Eta spans only the supplied Y stations; no unprovided wing root, tip or full planform is inferred. All coordinates are interpreted in metres. Upper/lower curve order must match the section contour order. Angle mapping is explicit in the workflow settings. XFOIL is a 2D section method without crossflow. Cp integration uses true section arc length and the explicitly selected initial-thickness assumption. synthetic_le_zero is a demonstration assumption; Cp=1 at the geometric LE is not exact compressible stagnation.
